title: zt (annotation root)
description: The serialized `zt` data the `annotation` template receives.

AnnotationTemplateContext.description: The `zt` root of the `annotation` template: one annotation (`TemplateAnnotation`) plus `citation`. Entries of `zt.annotations` on the note root carry no citation — only the single-annotation render resolves one.

citation.description: Page-pinned citation of `TemplateAnnotation.parentItem`, rendered through the `cite` template with this annotation's `pageLabel` as locator; `null` when there is no parent item or it carries no citation key. Computed at the app layer.

imgLink.description: Markdown link to the excerpt image, or `null` for annotation types with no cached excerpt image (everything but `image` and `ink`), which resolves empty. Call it to render and pipe it through the `embed` filter (or prefix `!` yourself) for an Obsidian embed. With image import disabled it links the cached image's `file://` URI; with import enabled it links the in-vault copy, formatted per the vault's wikilink preference. Pass `alias` to override the display text (defaults to the image filename). Computed at the app layer.

comment.description: `commentHtml` converted to Markdown; `null` when there is no comment. Computed at the app layer.

fileLink.description: Markdown link to the parent attachment file, deep-linked to this annotation's `page` (`#page=N`); `null` when the file is unresolvable. Call it to render — pass `alias`/`subpath` to override the display text or the `#`-fragment. Computed at the app layer.

backlink.description: Zotero deep link to this annotation. Computed at the app layer.

parentItem.description:
Parent literature item; shared across annotations from the same item. `null` for an annotation on a standalone attachment (a file with no parent bibliographic item).

Its `collections` are populated when the annotation renders as part of a note; see `TemplateParentItemData` for the standalone case.

parentAttachment.description: Source attachment; shared across annotations from the same attachment.

key.description: Zotero item key of the annotation.

indexedKey.description: `key` for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

libraryID.description: Zotero library ID holding the annotation.

type.description: Annotation kind: `"highlight"`, `"note"`, `"image"`, `"ink"`, `"underline"`, or `"text"`; `"unknown"` for a type Zotero added after this release.

text.description: The highlighted or underlined excerpt; `null` when the type carries none. Verbatim as Zotero stores it, so it can hold the attribute-free inline tags the reader's editor allows (`<i>`, `<b>`, `<sub>`, `<sup>`).

commentHtml.description: Raw comment HTML as stored by Zotero — "plain text flavored with some HTML tags" (only `<i>`/`<b>`/`<sub>`/`<sup>` plus `\n` line breaks); `null` when there is no comment. For rendered Markdown use `comment`.

colorName.description: Zotero palette name — `"yellow"`, `"red"`, `"green"`, `"blue"`, `"purple"`, `"magenta"`, `"orange"`, `"gray"`, or `"plum"`; `null` when `colorHex` is absent or holds a custom color outside the palette.

pageLabel.description: Page label as the document itself shows it, e.g. `"42"`, `"iv"`.

page.description: 1-based page number derived from the PDF position (`pageIndex + 1`); `null` for annotations with no page index (EPUB / snapshot). Unlike `pageLabel` this ignores the document's own page labelling.

authorName.description: Annotation author as stored on the annotation row; `null` when the row records none.

isExternal.description: Whether Zotero marks the annotation as external.

dateAdded.description: When the annotation was created. Second precision, like an item's timestamps.

dateModified.description: When the annotation was last modified; same precision as `dateAdded`.

TemplateParentItemData.description:
Parent literature item as seen from the standalone `annotation` template. The annot-view drag-insert resolves the item's tags but omits collection rows entirely — `collections` lives only on the note root. Read them there (`zt.collections`).

Item-type-specific Zotero fields beyond the typed ones above, each under its canonical name — e.g. `zt.conferenceName`, `zt.numPages`. A field Zotero maps to a base field is reachable through that base name alone: read `blogTitle` as `zt.publicationTitle`, `studio` as `zt.publisher`, `reportNumber` as `zt.number`, `thesisType` as `zt.type`.

notePath.description: Always `null` on a standalone annotation render (annotation-view drag/insert, note import) — resolving the parent's real literature-note path would require app-layer vault-index I/O, which the annotation path (synchronous on `dragstart`) intentionally avoids. Stubbed rather than omitted so `zt.parentItem.notePath` reads as "unresolved" instead of `undefined`.

noteLink.description: Always returns `null`, for the same reason as `notePath`.

key.description: Zotero item key, e.g. `"ABC12345"`; unique within its library.

groupID.description: Group library ID; `null` for the personal library.

libraryID.description: Zotero library ID holding the item.

indexedKey.description: `key` for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

dateAdded.description: When the item was added to Zotero. Second precision — Zotero stores the timestamp as a UTC string with no sub-second component. Renders as the local date (e.g. `2026-06-21`) in `{{ }}` output.

dateModified.description: When the item was last modified in Zotero; same precision and rendering as `dateAdded`.

creators.description: Every creator on the item, in Zotero's own order.

primaryCreatorType.description: The creator role Zotero treats as primary for this item type, e.g. `"author"` for a journal article, `"director"` for a film; `null` when the type defines none.

abstract.description: Abstract text. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's `abstractNote`, which stays accessible — both `zt.abstract` and `zt.abstractNote` work.

containerTitle.description: Journal or container title. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's `publicationTitle`, which stays accessible — both names work.

citationKey.description: Citation key, from Better BibTeX or Zotero's native citation key.

citekey.description: Alias for `citationKey`; both stay accessible on `zt.*`.

date.description: Publication date, parsed from Zotero's multipart `date` field.

language.description: Language, verbatim as Zotero stores it, e.g. `"en-US"`, `"English"`.

extra.description: Parsed best-effort from Zotero's free-text `extra` field; prints `raw`. `null` when the field is empty or absent.

weblink.description: Zotero web library URL (`https://www.zotero.org/...`); `null` for a never-synced personal library.

authors.description: Creators filtered to the item's primary creator type; all when none matches.

authorsShort.description: Formatted short author string, e.g. `"Smith et al."`.

TemplateCreator.description: One creator of an item, in the template vocabulary. Coerces to `TemplateCreator.fullName` in string contexts.

family.description: Family / last name; empty for institutional creators.

given.description: Given / first name; empty for institutional creators.

literal.description: Full name for institutional / single-name authors (Zotero `fieldMode=1`); `null` for personal names.

fullName.description: `literal` for institutional creators, `"given family"` for personal names.

TemplateTag.description: A Tag in the template vocabulary. Coerces to `name` in string contexts (like a collection coerces to its name), so `{{ zt.tags | join: ", " }}` renders tag names directly. Zotero-internal IDs are dropped; `type` is the resolved name rather than Zotero's raw int.

name.description: Tag name as shown in Zotero.

type.description: `"manual"` for a hand-added tag, `"auto"` for an automatic one (a translator or plugin attached it while saving or importing); `"unknown"` for a type id Zotero added after this mapping was written.

ItemDateYMD.description: Full Y/M/D date parsed into a `Temporal.PlainDate`.

raw.description: The stored Zotero `date` value verbatim, retained for round-tripping.

day.description: Always `null` — this variant carries no day.

raw.description: The stored Zotero `date` value verbatim, retained for round-tripping.

ItemDateYear.description: Year only. Also covers Zotero's `01 2003` misparse where the user-string day is meaningful but month is missing (the spurious day is dropped since no `Temporal` type fits "year + day without month").

value.description: Always `null` — no `Temporal` type holds a bare year.

month.description: Always `null` — the month is missing or unparseable.

day.description: Always `null` — this variant carries no day.

raw.description: The stored Zotero `date` value verbatim, retained for round-tripping.

ItemDateText.description: Unparseable / text-only: the year is missing or the SQL prefix is absent.

value.description: Always `null` — nothing parsed, so there is no `Temporal` value.

text.description: The renderable user portion, or the entire raw value when non-multipart.

year.description: Year extracted from `ItemDateText.text` when it holds a standalone 4-digit year in the 1000-2999 range, else `null`.

month.description: Always `null` — the text variant resolves no month.

day.description: Always `null` — the text variant resolves no day.

raw.description: The stored Zotero `date` value verbatim, retained for round-tripping.

ItemExtra.description:
Best-effort structured view of Zotero's `extra` field. Plain data so it is directly indexable in Liquid, Eta, and JS.

`toString` is non-enumerable, so a spread, `JSON.stringify`, or `Object.keys` sees the three data properties alone.

raw.description: Original field text verbatim, for a full round-trip.

fields.description: First value per key — the common-case lookup, e.g. `zt.extra.fields["tex.mendeley-tags"]`. First-wins: a repeated key keeps its first occurrence.

lines.description: Every source row in order, the source of truth `ItemExtra.fields` derives from. Scan it to recover every value of a repeated key.

value.description: Parsed value, trimmed; always non-empty on a pair row.

key.description: Always `null` — prose, blank, and empty-value rows carry no key.

ExtraLine.description:
One source row of an Extra field, in document order: a parsed pair (`key` plus trimmed `value`) or a non-pair text/blank row (`key: null`). `raw` is the verbatim line so interleaved prose is never dropped.

A line splits on its first `:` or `=`, and is a pair only when the key starts with an ASCII letter and otherwise holds ASCII letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens, or underscores. A line that does not match, and one whose value is empty, becomes a text row.

A non-enumerable `toString` returns `raw`, as on the extra field itself.

TemplateAttachment.description: Attachment data in the v2 template vocabulary. Exposed on `zt.attachments` and as `parentAttachment` on each annotation.

key.description: Zotero item key of the attachment.

indexedKey.description: `key` for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

filename.description: Filename resolved from the attachment path; null for URL / unknown links.

linkMode.description: Resolved link mode — `"imported_file"`, `"imported_url"`, `"linked_file"`, `"linked_url"`, or `"embedded_image"`; `"unknown"` when the raw mode is null or unrecognized.

backlink.description: Zotero deep link to open this attachment in the reader (`zotero://open/...`).

filePath.description: Absolute on-disk path to the attachment file; `null` for URL links, an unset base directory, or an unparseable path. Computed at the app layer.

fileLink.description: Markdown link to the on-disk attachment file. In Liquid it renders on plain access (`{{ a.fileLink }}`); pipe the attachment itself through the `file_link` filter to override the alias or subpath. In Eta call it — `<%= a.fileLink() %>` — passing `alias` to override the display text (defaults to the filename) and `subpath` to append a `#`-fragment. `null` when the file is unresolvable. Computed at the app layer.

oneOf.description: Text marked with a highlight color.
A note pinned to a spot on the page.
A rectangular area selection, saved with an excerpt image.
A freehand drawing, saved with an excerpt image.
Free text typed onto the page.
A type id Zotero added after this mapping was written.

ResolvedAnnotationTypeName.description: A resolved annotation type name: one Zotero declares, or `"unknown"` for a type id Zotero added after this mapping was written.
